environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet (no IGW route) with the container exposed exclusively through an AWS Lambda function URL configured as a proxy. The Lambda function URL has AuthType set to AWS_IAM. The Lambda's resource-based policy specifies a Condition block with 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' restricting invocation to principals within the organization (o-abc123def4). The Lambda function itself forwards requests to the Fargate task via a VPC-attached ENI through a PrivateLink interface endpoint. The Fargate task's security group only allows inbound TCP/8080 from the Lambda function's security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f). There is no NAT gateway, no public IP assignment on the task, and no other ingress path. CloudWatch Logs show that unauthenticated requests to the function URL receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service itself before any code executes.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, 0.5 vCPU, 1GB RAM, private subnet

networking.lambda_vpc_config: Attached to same VPC, private subnet

config.public_exposure: None - no ALB, no API Gateway, no public IP
